Critical power and W' for everyone signed up to a race

Source: R/cp.R
zv_signups_cp.Rd

Runs zv_rider_cp() for every rider on a race's ZwiftPower sign-up list, optionally one pen only.

Usage

zv_signups_cp(zr, zp, race_id, pen = NULL, ..., progress = interactive())

Arguments

zr

A zr_client(), or NULL to use only the ZwiftPower fit.

zp

A zp_session() (required: the sign-ups come from ZwiftPower).

race_id

ZwiftPower (= Zwift) event id.

pen

Optional pen letter(s), e.g. "C".

...

Passed to zv_rider_cp() (max_age_days, durations, tries).

progress

Show a progress bar.

Value

A tibble with one row per signed-up rider: zwid, name, team, pen, weight (kg, from the sign-up), the columns of zv_rider_cp(), plus cp_wkg and w_prime_jkg.

Details

Each rider can cost a ZwiftPower race-history request, up to tries ZwiftRacing.app results requests and a ZwiftPower power-curve request. All are cached. ZwiftRacing allows a user key at most one results request a minute, so with zr a large field can take a long time the first time; pass zr = NULL for a quick ZwiftPower-only table. If the key has no results allowance at all, ZwiftRacing is dropped after the first rider.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zr <- zr_client()
zp <- zp_set_cookie(zp_session(), Sys.getenv("ZP_SID"))
field <- zv_signups_cp(zr, zp, 5812345, pen = "C")
dplyr::arrange(field, dplyr::desc(cp_wkg))
} # }
